headline_result: The aligned null-hub + two-sided stars + exact rank-two physical cross packet is NOT by itself an L-infinity receiver under arbitrary same-bank curvature, even in arbitrarily strict N3 physical geometry. An explicit rank-two family A=aa^T-bb^T has star energies 2,2, cross singulars 1,1, exact alignment, and logarithmically unbounded output density for iid uniform cap-one inputs. It is not a full target counterexample because it has only two nonzero eigenvalues. Adding a disjoint flat rank-one third spectral packet makes a full-target strict-N3 stress family paid continuously by the completed source-disjoint weighted-Fourier theorem with bound <22.105.
